description: Fix swipe-to-reply gesture recognition in DM bubbles. The horizontal drag handler in dm_message_bubble.dart (around line 327) has a dx > 0 guard that prevents the gesture recognizer from claiming the gesture when the first pointer movement has any vertical component, causing the vertical ScrollablePositionedList to win the gesture arena. Also lower the reply trigger threshold from 56px to 36px for a snappier feel.
steps: In zendapp/lib/src/features/dm/dm_message_bubble.dart, locate the onHorizontalDragUpdate handler (around line 327). Remove the `if (details.delta.dx > 0 && widget.onReply != null)` guard and replace it with just `if (widget.onReply != null)`. The clamp(0.0, 72.0) already prevents negative movement values from accumulating, so the dx > 0 check is redundant but harmful because it prevents the recognizer from claiming the gesture on frames where dx <= 0.
In the same handler, change the trigger threshold from `_swipeDx >= 56` to `_swipeDx >= 36` for a lower reply activation distance.
acceptance_criteria: The onHorizontalDragUpdate handler no longer has a `details.delta.dx > 0` guard wrapping the setState call
The reply trigger threshold is 36px instead of 56px
